No combat/health/animation scripts are created, per scope.

{"files":[{"path":"ServerScriptService/Forge_c7540d7b8984/DummySafetyAndPlacement.server.luau","kind":"Script","source":"-- DummySafetyAndPlacement
-- Integration + safety enforcement for the approved Marketplace Training Dummy
-- (asset id 1245720733) at Workspace/Forge_c7540d7b8984/World/Dummy.
--
-- This script does not fabricate the dummy's geometry. It waits for the real
-- imported asset content to be present under the Dummy container, then:
--   1. Anchors every BasePart (or, if a Humanoid rig is present, neutralizes it)
--      so the model is a completely stationary, non-physics prop.
--   2. Disables any embedded Script/LocalScript found anywhere in the model so
--      no retaliation, damage-taking, attack, or self-movement logic can run,
--      continuing to guard against anything added later (e.g. by the embedded
--      script itself before it is disabled).
--   3. Neutralizes any Humanoid so it can never lose health, be defeated, or
--      move on its own.
--   4. Places the model upright, flush on the Pedestal's TopPlate, facing the
--      exact same forward direction as PlayerSpawn.
--   5. Creates exactly one canonical hit-detection reference point ("HitTarget")
--      at a consistent torso-height location. No health, damage, or retaliation
--      behavior is attached to this point or anywhere else on the dummy.

local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local root = Workspace:WaitForChild("Forge_c7540d7b8984")
local world = root:WaitForChild("World")
local pedestal = world:WaitForChild("Pedestal")
local topPlate = pedestal:WaitForChild("TopPlate")
local spawnPoint = world:WaitForChild("PlayerSpawn")
local dummy = world:WaitForChild("Dummy")

local HIT_TARGET_NAME = "HitTarget"

-- ---- Safety sanitization ----

local function sanitizeInstance(inst)
	if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
		-- Stationary, solid target: never physically simulated, always collidable.
		inst.Anchored = true
		inst.CanCollide = true
	elseif inst:IsA("Script") or inst:IsA("LocalScript") then
		-- The dummy must never retaliate, deal damage, or move on its own.
		-- Disable any embedded logic found on the imported model.
		inst.Disabled = true
	elseif inst:IsA("Humanoid") then
		-- No health/defeat condition, no self-movement.
		inst.MaxHealth = math.huge
		inst.Health = math.huge
		inst.WalkSpeed = 0
		inst.JumpPower = 0
		pcall(function()
			inst.JumpHeight = 0
		end)
		inst.PlatformStand = true
		inst.HealthChanged:Connect(function()
			if inst.Health < inst.MaxHealth then
				inst.Health = inst.MaxHealth
			end
		end)
	end
end

-- Sanitize everything already present, then keep guarding anything added later
-- (for example if the embedded script spawns something before being disabled).
for _, inst in ipairs(dummy:GetDescendants()) do
	sanitizeInstance(inst)
end
dummy.DescendantAdded:Connect(sanitizeInstance)

if dummy.PrimaryPart then
	dummy.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true
	dummy.PrimaryPart.CanCollide = true
end

-- ---- Wait for the real imported asset content to exist ----

local function hasAnyBasePart()
	for _, inst in ipairs(dummy:GetDescendants()) do
		if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local waited = 0
while not hasAnyBasePart() and waited < 10 do
	task.wait(0.25)
	waited += 0.25
end

if not hasAnyBasePart() then
	warn("[DummySafetyAndPlacement] No BasePart content found under World/Dummy; placement and HitTarget were skipped. The Training Dummy asset (1245720733) content was not present to configure.")
	return
end

-- ---- Placement: upright on the Pedestal's TopPlate, facing PlayerSpawn's forward direction ----

local spawnCFrame = spawnPoint.CFrame
local facing = spawnCFrame.Rotation -- match spawn's forward direction exactly

local topSurfaceY = topPlate.Position.Y + (topPlate.Size.Y / 2)
local targetX = topPlate.Position.X
local targetZ = topPlate.Position.Z

-- Lift well above the pedestal first so the bounding-box measurement below is not
-- confused by overlap with pedestal geometry, then measure the dummy's real height.
dummy:PivotTo(CFrame.new(targetX, topSurfaceY + 50, targetZ) * facing)

local ok, _, boundingSize = pcall(function()
	return dummy:GetBoundingBox()
end)

if not ok or not boundingSize then
	warn("[DummySafetyAndPlacement] Could not measure Dummy bounding box; placement skipped.")
	return
end

local halfHeight = boundingSize.Y / 2

-- Final resting CFrame: feet flush on the pedestal top, facing matches PlayerSpawn.
local finalCFrame = CFrame.new(targetX, topSurfaceY + halfHeight, targetZ) * facing
dummy:PivotTo(finalCFrame)

-- ---- Canonical hit reference point ----
-- Exactly one BasePart exposed as the single hit-detection reference point that a
-- future CombatService will measure distance/facing against. No health, damage or
-- retaliation behavior is attached here or anywhere else on the dummy.
if not dummy:FindFirstChild(HIT_TARGET_NAME) then
	local hitTarget = Instance.new("Part")
	hitTarget.Name = HIT_TARGET_NAME
	hitTarget.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1.5)
	hitTarget.Transparency = 1
	hitTarget.CanCollide = false
	hitTarget.CanQuery = true
	hitTarget.CanTouch = false
	hitTarget.Massless = true
	hitTarget.Anchored = true
	-- Torso-height: proportionally up the dummy's measured height from its feet.
	local torsoY = topSurfaceY + (boundingSize.Y * 0.55)
	hitTarget.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetX, torsoY, targetZ) * facing
	hitTarget.Parent = dummy
end
